title: Days Like This Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Designed with gracious living in mind, the grand ‘Days Like This’ cottage serves up an elegant twist on your beach vacation.
description_expanded: Description201 SMOLIAN CIRCLE3 KINGS, 1 QUEENS, 1 FULL, 2 TWINSGrand Coastal Elegance in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaDesigned with gracious coastal living in mind, Days Like This (formerly Now and Then) is a stately Seaside cottage that elevates the beach vacation experience with timeless architecture, refined interiors, and generous gathering spaces. From its iconic white columns to sun-filled rooms throughout, this impressive home blends classic Southern charm with upscale comfort—perfectly positioned for an unforgettable stay in Seaside, Florida.Sophisticated Living Spaces Made for GatheringInside, the home offers a polished take on the traditional beach retreat, featuring expansive open living areas accented by high-end furnishings, elegant finishes, and abundant natural light. A statement chandelier anchors the main living space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for relaxing or entertaining. Nearby, the thoughtfully designed kitchen is equipped with premium appliances, including a double oven, providing ample space to prepare meals while staying connected with family and friends.Main-Level Comfort with Private SuitesThe ground floor hosts a serene king primary suite, complete with a private bathroom featuring dual pedestal sinks, a Jacuzzi tub, and a separate walk-in shower. An additional guest bedroom with a full-size bed and its own private bath is also located on this level, offering convenience and privacy for guests who prefer single-level living.Expansive Second Floor with Balcony LivingAscending the sweeping staircase reveals a second living area and four additional bedrooms, each designed for comfort and retreat. This level includes two king bedrooms and one queen bedroom, all with private en-suite bathrooms, as well as a twin bedroom with its own bath. The king and queen bedrooms share access to an open-air balcony furnished with seating and a swing—an ideal spot for enjoying morning coffee or winding down after a day at the beach.Tower Views and Quiet Retreats Above the TreetopsThe third level introduces a cozy library and sitting area, perfect for reading or quiet reflection. Above it all, the enclosed fourth-level tower room delivers a true showstopper—surrounded by windows and offering sweeping 360-degree views over Seaside’s rooftops and treetops. This light-filled space feels as though it floats above the town, providing a peaceful escape unlike any other.Ideal for Large Groups Seeking Space and StyleWith six bedrooms and seven bathrooms, Days Like This is perfectly suited for large families or groups of friends seeking a refined Seaside getaway with room to spread out and gather together. Thoughtfully designed living spaces, multiple indoor and outdoor gathering areas, and architectural character throughout make this home a standout choice for those searching for a luxury vacation rental in Seaside, Florida.Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance.Sat to Sat 7 night minimum Summer; 5 night minimum Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES3,279 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceWest Ruskin Pavilion private Seaside residential beach176 yards | 3-minute walk to beach accessThree king bedrooms, each with a private en-suite bathroomBose SoundTouch SA-5 amplifier with Bluetooth, Spotify, Apple AirPlay, and Bose SoundTouch app connectivityWasher and dryer on both floors for added convenienceSteps from Central Square and the beach, placing you in the heart of SeasidePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002093
